hook: Sundar Pichai joined Google in 2004 to lead product work on its client software, including the Chrome browser, and rose to run Android and then all of Google's products. He became Google's chief executive when Alphabet was formed in 2015 and Alphabet's chief executive in December 2019. In 2023 he announced the merger of Google Brain and DeepMind into Google DeepMind and introduced the Gemini family of AI models.

quick_facts: Born in Tamil Nadu, India, in 1972, he studied metallurgical engineering at IIT Kharagpur, materials science at Stanford University and business at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.
Before Google he worked in engineering and product management at Applied Materials and briefly as a consultant at McKinsey & Company.
At Google he was senior vice president for Android, Chrome and Apps and from October 2014 oversaw product and engineering across Google's internet businesses.
Larry Page named him CEO of Google on August 10, 2015, and he also became CEO of Alphabet on December 3, 2019.
Announcing Google DeepMind on April 20, 2023, he wrote that Google had been an AI-first company since 2016.
India awarded him the Padma Bhushan for trade and industry in 2022, and TIME named him to its 2024 TIME100 AI list.

achievements.title: Chrome and ChromeOS
achievements.impact: Led product work on Google's browser and its operating system, which he demonstrated in November 2009 and which shipped on Chromebooks from 2011.

achievements.title: Leadership of Google and Alphabet
achievements.impact: Became CEO of Google in 2015 and of Alphabet in 2019, when co-founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin stepped back from executive roles.

achievements.title: Google DeepMind formation
achievements.impact: Announced April 20, 2023, combining the Brain team from Google Research with DeepMind in one unit led by Demis Hassabis.

achievements.title: Gemini model family
achievements.impact: Introduced December 6, 2023, as Google's first models built to handle text, images, audio and video from the start, in Ultra, Pro and Nano sizes.
